summary.title: Alignment review: stakeholder-safe release handoff
summary.detail: A derived, read-only view of the current dossier. It preserves evidence, uncertainty, and review findings for a human decision.

goals.title: Expose evidence before a decision
goals.detail: Present goals, behavior, architecture, and review findings without turning them into a semantic certificate.

goals.title: Keep consent separate
goals.detail: The Site is a presentation surface; the host conversation is the explicit human decision channel.

stakeholders.title: Review sponsor
stakeholders.detail: Assesses whether the evidence supports a handoff decision.

stakeholders.title: Delivery team
stakeholders.detail: Maintains dossier artifacts and resolves work after review.

useCases.title: Review a handoff dossier
useCases.detail: A stakeholder consults evidence references, reads open findings, and gives consent outside the Site.

behavior.title: Findings remain visible
behavior.detail: Given an open finding, when the review is rendered, then it appears before snapshot readiness.

behavior.title: Uncertainty is not hidden
behavior.detail: Given an uncertain proposition, when it is rendered, then its text label identifies it as uncertain.

responsibilities.title: Review Site
responsibilities.detail: Renders the supplied payload and never writes a decision or approval record.

responsibilities.title: Canonical dossier
responsibilities.detail: Remains the source of truth for all review evidence.

decisions.title: Keep the renderer presentational
decisions.detail: The template accepts dossier-authored presentation data and makes no semantic claims.

risks.title: Consent may be premature
risks.detail: Open findings require stakeholder judgment and can block a handoff.

findings.title: Acceptance threshold is unresolved
findings.detail: The sponsor must decide whether the open threshold is sufficient for handoff.

findings.title: Ownership is conflicting
findings.detail: The delivery owner named in two source artifacts differs and needs a human resolution.
